answer: One defence is Incorporated grid operator registration with grid authority attestation: a registration the authority renews after network audits, and the ridge of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the marble is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the meadow of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
